thm maximum_edge_endpoint:
    ? forall edge, left_one, left_two, right_one, right_two R+:
        left_one <= edge
        left_two <= edge
        right_one <= edge
        right_two <= edge
        edge < left_one + right_one
        edge < left_two + right_two
        =>:
            $triangle_edges(edge, left_one, left_two) or $triangle_edges(edge, right_one, right_two)
    by cases:
        ? $triangle_edges(edge, left_one, left_two) or $triangle_edges(edge, right_one, right_two)
        case edge < left_one + left_two:
            left_one < edge + left_two
            left_two < edge + left_one
            by def $triangle_edges(edge, left_one, left_two)
        case edge >= left_one + left_two:
            edge + edge < (left_one + right_one) + (left_two + right_two)
            (left_one + right_one) + (left_two + right_two) = (left_one + left_two) + (right_one + right_two)
            (left_one + left_two) + (right_one + right_two) <= edge + (right_one + right_two)
            edge < right_one + right_two
            right_one < edge + right_two
            right_two < edge + right_one
            by def $triangle_edges(edge, right_one, right_two)

claim:
    ? forall ab, ac, ad, bc, bd, cd R+:
        $triangle_edges(ab, ac, bc)
        $triangle_edges(ab, ad, bd)
        $triangle_edges(ac, ad, cd)
        $triangle_edges(bc, bd, cd)
        =>:
            $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
    let longest = finite_set_max({ab, ac, ad, bc, bd, cd})
    longest $in {ab, ac, ad, bc, bd, cd}
    ab <= longest
    ac <= longest
    ad <= longest
    bc <= longest
    bd <= longest
    cd <= longest
    by cases:
        ? $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
        case longest = ab:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ab, ac, ad, bc, bd)
        case longest = ac:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ac, ab, ad, bc, cd)
        case longest = ad:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ad, ab, ac, bd, cd)
        case longest = bc:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bc, ab, bd, ac, cd)
        case longest = bd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bd, ab, bc, ad, cd)
        case longest = cd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(cd, ac, bc, ad, bd)

claim:
    ? forall ab, ac, ad, bc, bd, cd R+:
        $triangle_edges(ab, ac, bc)
        $triangle_edges(ab, ad, bd)
        $triangle_edges(ac, ad, cd)
        $triangle_edges(bc, bd, cd)
        =>:
            $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
    let longest = max(ab, max(ac, max(ad, max(bc, max(bd, cd)))))
    longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
    ab <= longest
    ac <= longest
    ad <= longest
    bc <= longest
    bd <= longest
    cd <= longest
    by cases:
        ? $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
        case longest = ab:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ab, ac, ad, bc, bd)
        case longest = ac:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ac, ab, ad, bc, cd)
        case longest = ad:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ad, ab, ac, bd, cd)
        case longest = bc:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bc, ab, bd, ac, cd)
        case longest = bd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bd, ab, bc, ad, cd)
        case longest = cd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(cd, ac, bc, ad, bd)

claim:
    ? forall ab, ac, ad, bc, bd, cd R+:
        $triangle_edges(ab, ac, bc)
        $triangle_edges(ab, ad, bd)
        $triangle_edges(ac, ad, cd)
        $triangle_edges(bc, bd, cd)
        =>:
            $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
    let lengths = union({ab}, union({ac}, union({ad}, union({bc}, union({bd}, {cd})))))
    let longest = finite_set_max(lengths)
    longest $in lengths
    ab <= longest
    ac <= longest
    ad <= longest
    bc <= longest
    bd <= longest
    cd <= longest
    by cases:
        ? $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
        case longest = ab:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ab, ac, ad, bc, bd)
        case longest = ac:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ac, ab, ad, bc, cd)
        case longest = ad:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ad, ab, ac, bd, cd)
        case longest = bc:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bc, ab, bd, ac, cd)
        case longest = bd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bd, ab, bc, ad, cd)
        case longest = cd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(cd, ac, bc, ad, bd)

claim:
    ? forall ab, ac, ad, bc, bd, cd R+:
        $triangle_edges(ab, ac, bc)
        $triangle_edges(ab, ad, bd)
        $triangle_edges(ac, ad, cd)
        $triangle_edges(bc, bd, cd)
        =>:
            $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
    let tail_bd = max(bd, cd)
    let tail_bc = max(bc, tail_bd)
    let tail_ad = max(ad, tail_bc)
    let tail_ac = max(ac, tail_ad)
    let longest = max(ab, tail_ac)
    claim:
        ? longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
        by cases:
            ? longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
            case ab >= tail_ac:
                longest = ab
                longest = ab
            case ab < tail_ac:
                longest = tail_ac
                by cases:
                    ? longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
                    case ac >= tail_ad:
                        tail_ac = ac
                        longest = ac
                    case ac < tail_ad:
                        tail_ac = tail_ad
                        by cases:
                            ? longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
                            case ad >= tail_bc:
                                tail_ad = ad
                                longest = ad
                            case ad < tail_bc:
                                tail_ad = tail_bc
                                by cases:
                                    ? longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
                                    case bc >= tail_bd:
                                        tail_bc = bc
                                        longest = bc
                                    case bc < tail_bd:
                                        tail_bc = tail_bd
                                        by cases:
                                            ? longest = ab or longest = ac or longest = ad or longest = bc or longest = bd or longest = cd
                                            case bd >= cd:
                                                tail_bd = bd
                                                longest = bd
                                            case bd < cd:
                                                tail_bd = cd
                                                longest = cd

    ab <= longest
    ac <= tail_ac <= longest
    ad <= tail_ad <= tail_ac <= longest
    bc <= tail_bc <= tail_ad <= tail_ac <= longest
    bd <= tail_bd <= tail_bc <= tail_ad <= tail_ac <= longest
    cd <= tail_bd <= tail_bc <= tail_ad <= tail_ac <= longest
    by cases:
        ? $triangle_edges(ab, ac, ad) or $triangle_edges(ab, bc, bd) or $triangle_edges(ac, bc, cd) or $triangle_edges(ad, bd, cd)
        case longest = ab:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ab, ac, ad, bc, bd)
        case longest = ac:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ac, ab, ad, bc, cd)
        case longest = ad:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(ad, ab, ac, bd, cd)
        case longest = bc:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bc, ab, bd, ac, cd)
        case longest = bd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(bd, ab, bc, ad, cd)
        case longest = cd:
            release thm maximum_edge_endpoint(cd, ac, bc, ad, bd)
